name: OmniParser Engine
problem: Traditional parser generators produce massive, opaque binary state machines that are impossible to debug interactively or modify dynamically at runtime.
pain: Writing custom parsers for complex domain-specific languages requires boilerplate tokenizers, error recovery logic, and manual AST builders that are tedious and error-prone.
solution: Provide a modular C11 parser framework with an interactive grammar validator, FIRST/FOLLOW set calculator, shift-reduce conflict resolver, and deterministic AST generator.
verification: Unit tests validate grammar compilation correctness against ambiguous grammars, left-recursion detection, and malformed input token streams, emitting strict diagnostic exit codes.
major_features: Custom regex-based lexer generator supporting user-defined token classes and literal patterns
LR(1) and LL(*) parse table construction engine calculating FIRST and FOLLOW sets automatically
Shift-reduce and reduce-reduce conflict detection and interactive resolution strategy harness
Explicit Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) node allocator with automatic memory pooling and type safety
Syntax-directed translation execution engine binding semantic actions directly to grammar productions
Panic-mode error recovery subsystem synchronizing token streams upon lexical and grammatical failures
Interactive parser state visualizer dumping deterministic state machine graphs to human-readable text
Comprehensive regression test suite validating malformed token inputs and boundary recursion limits
truth_policy: Only validated behavior may be claimed as working.
